articles.title: Spain dominates the new FIFPro World XI with four players, without the Ballon d'Or
articles.standfirst: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.summary: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.body:
The Spanish National Team has been recognized for the World Cup won in the United States with the inclusion of four of its players in the FIFPro World XI . David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the best eleven players of last season.

In the midst of a World Cup year , voters have had to choose from the last 26 finalists the 11 best players of the past campaign. The previous edition was dominated by PSG , with as many as five footballers from Luis Enrique’s team. This season, four Spaniards feature in the FIFPro World XI: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal.

As in the previous season, there is still significant representation from the Parisian side, two-time Champions League winner , with Achraf Hakimi, Nuno Mendes and Vitinha.

On Real Madrid's side, the presence of Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé stands out. In a lineup in which the absence of the brand-new Ballon d'Or winner, Harry Kane , is striking, the other two spots are filled by Erling Haaland and Leo Messi .

Therefore, the FIFPro 2026 World XI is as follows: David Raya; Achraf Hakimi, Pau Cubarsí, Nuno Mendes; Rodri, Vitinha, Bellingham; Messi, Yamal, Mbappé and Haaland.

David Raya has been the player who has accumulated the most votes across all positions . 51.9% of the footballers chose the Arsenal goalkeeper as the best of last season, far ahead of the runner-up; Courtois (38.6%). Among the defenders, Pau Cubarsí, with 26.8%, was only surpassed by Hakimi (40.9%).

Among the midfielders , Rodri leads the list with 33.1% , closely followed by Bellingham ( 31.3% ). And in the forwards area, 46% of the voters chose Mbappé , and 37.4% chose Lamine Yamal . Behind them, Messi (29.5%) and Haaland (28.4%) left out Harry Kane (27.6%), in a lineup with four attackers .

An unprecedented situation

The absence of Bayern Munich 's " number nine " is something extraordinary . For the first time since this award began in 2005 , the winner of the Ballon d'Or that same year has not been included afterward in the ideal FIFPro team.

The voting was carried out by 19,806 footballers from 73 countries who assessed "their performances between 4 August 2025 and 19 July 2026 , both inclusive, during which they must have played at least 30 official matches".

With the four appearances in this new edition, Spain widens its lead as the country with the highest number of appearances in the Men's World XI , with 53 selections shared among 17 players . In addition, Lamine Yamal becomes the first player in history to appear for the second time in the FIFPro World XI before the age of 20.

articles.title: "We're going to take advantage of it": Araújo's provocative remark about Messi before Argentina-Uruguay that heats up the friendly
articles.standfirst: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.summary: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.body:
The Argentina national team will face a special test this Friday, November 13, when it hosts Uruguay at La Bombonera. It will be its first match after Lionel Messi 's farewell from the national team and, ahead of the game, people from La Celeste have already started heating up the Río de la Plata clásico with controversial statements.

One of those who spoke was Ronald Araújo, who knows the Argentine captain very well from having shared a dressing room with him at Barcelona. The Uruguayan defender did not avoid the subject of his absence and issued a warning that quickly drew attention: "In the end they lost the best player in the world, and we're going to take advantage of that."

Araújo's warning to the Argentina national team over Messi

The footballer made it clear that Uruguay will try to take advantage of the Albiceleste's new reality. However, he also acknowledged that Lionel Scaloni's team retains significant pedigree and that it will not be easy to face them. "They have great players, they have young players with a lot of quality, they are a great powerhouse", he said.

Araújo also highlighted the difficulty of facing Argentina and anticipated that Uruguay will seek to impose its style of play . "All matches against Argentina are difficult, but we are going to show our football and continue growing as a national team" added the defender, who is preparing for one of the most attractive matches of the FIFA international break.

Araújo will have a special duel with Alexis Mac Allister

The clásico will also have a particular twist for the Uruguayan defender: on the other side will be Alexis Mac Allister, his teammate at Liverpool. Araújo acknowledged that there had already been some joking between the two footballers ahead of the match. "We've already teased each other a little," he said, referring to the clash with his eyes on a duel that will have a special edge because it is Scaloni's first match without Messi.

The match will mark the beginning of a new era for the Argentine national team, which will have to face its commitments without the presence of its historic captain.

After the match against Uruguay, Scaloni's team will face Costa Rica on Tuesday, November 17, in Córdoba.

While Argentina will seek to show that it remains competitive without Messi, Uruguay will arrive hoping to take advantage of the new scenario.

articles.title: Shae Cruyff, Johan's grandson, called up by the United States
articles.standfirst: The legacy of the former Dutch player continues: he is an under-18 international
articles.summary: The legacy of the former Dutch player continues: he is an under-18 international
articles.body:
The surname Cruyff remains linked to the world of football. The legacy of the legendary former player and former coach, who passed away in 2016, lives on. Following the career of his son, Jordi, it is now his grandson Shea who is taking important steps in the sport: he has been called up to the United States under-18 national team.

Shea Cruyff-Beane, the youngest son of Chantal Cruyff, was called up in recent hours by the American national team, which will play two matches. Johan's grandson, who plays as a midfielder, is part of the youth ranks of Nàstic de Tarragona.

Shea holds three nationalities: Spain (where he was born), the Netherlands (his maternal family's country of origin), and the United States (his father's origin). He has now been called up by the American U18 team, but he could still change his national team in the future.

Football has always been a part of Shea 's life, since he is not only the grandson and nephew of professionals in this sport, but his father, Todd Beane, played for Dartmouth College, in the first division of the NCAA, and even went on to play professionally in his country.

The United States U18 team will face Portugal and Norway in the Lusitanian country.

articles.title: Pochettino accused of using USMNT “losers” to land Manchester United job: “He was just pretending”
articles.standfirst: Harsh article by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport against the United States national team coach
articles.summary: Harsh article by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport against the United States national team coach
articles.body:
The more than likely arrival of Mauricio Pochettino to the Manchester United bench, and the consequent breaking of the agreement the Argentine coach had with the United States national team until 2030, is one of the topics of the day.

Among all the published articles, the opinion column written this Wednesday by Brian T. Smith in TalkSport stands out, in which the author claims that "Mauricio Pochettino used the US national team's "losers""... to land his dream job".

Mauricio Pochettino told everyone who would listen that this moment would come. The big question for the United States men's national team is whether the U.S. Soccer Federation was smart enough to prepare for the inevitable , Brian T. Smith asks.

Pochettino's objective was always the Premier League

In the article, the author recalls that Pochettino always wanted what is about to happen: to return to the Premier League after the World Cup . "Now focused on the United States national team, perhaps one day I will return to the Premier League ," he said in a previous interview with TalkSport.

"The reality was that Pochettino fell frustratingly short with Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Chris Richards, Christian Pulisic and a group of talents that was supposed to be the best U.S. soccer had ever produced ," criticizes Smith, who believes that Pochettino's interest in developing U.S. soccer was fictitious , as the Federation promised after the renewal.

Manchester United is ready to pay the $10 million release clause in the coach's contract , which was in force until 2030 before becoming worthless paper.

A problem for USMNT: replacement sought

" Pochettino was only acting when he pretended to love the United States national team . Which team would you rather manage: Manchester United or the United States national team?", he quips.

"Until soccer becomes a major sport in the United States, the search for a head coach truly committed to the United States will always be the same ," the article predicts.

"The United States national soccer team will have been nothing more than a springboard to something bigger and better on a brighter stage ," Smith concludes.

articles.title: Pep Guardiola emerges as shock USMNT target amid Manchester United domino effect
articles.standfirst: If Manchester United pulls the trigger on Pochettino, US Soccer is ready to swing for the absolute fences. Could Pep Guardiola really be heading to the USMNT?
articles.summary: If Manchester United pulls the trigger on Pochettino, US Soccer is ready to swing for the absolute fences. Could Pep Guardiola really be heading to the USMNT?
articles.body:
On the verge of beginning the quarterfinal round of the Concacaf Nations League , the United States national team is going through a turbulent moment, as its project toward 2030 could be altered.

Their coach Mauricio Pochettino , who was retained despite the poor results prior to the 2026 World Cup , where he was eliminated in the round of 16, is the main target of Manchester United to rebuild a season in which they are in the relegation zone after 10 matchdays with Michael Carrick in charge.

Pep Guardiola, an option for the United States?

In what appears to be an imminent departure of the Argentine manager to the Premier League , where he stood out with Tottenham , a name of global significance is already beginning to emerge.

According to information from The Athletic, “ US Soccer is expected to make Pep Guardiola a top target to replace Mauricio Pochettino if the men’s national team coach leaves for Manchester United,” reports the sports outlet of The New York Times.

This is not the first time that the U.S. federation has intended to be able to hire the former Manchester City coach, since it also had him on its list ahead of the 2022 Qatar World Cup , The Athletic adds.

Guardiola has shown interest in the United States

Guardiola, who lived in New York after leaving Barcelona in 2012 and before joining Bayern Munich in 2013, has shown interest in Team USA in the past.

“ The United States is fascinating for trying to build a project over many years and being able to take the national team to the next level . The potential of the United States is there, because of the large number of people and sports,” he said in 2024.

Team USA faces Haiti in the quarterfinals of the Concacaf Nations League next Saturday away in Jamaica, where the Mexican National Team will also play; the Haitians cannot play in their country due to the turbulent political situation, and they host the second leg on Tuesday in Cincinnati. These matches are expected to be managed by Pochettino, and then the search for the new head coach would begin.

Rafa Márquez could come up against his coach from Barcelona

If this supposed possibility were to materialize, Rafa Márquez could face Joseph Guardiola for the first time as a coach, and it would be in a Mexico vs United States . Both were together at FC Barcelona between 2008 and 2010, the first years as head coach of the first team for the former Dorados de Sinaloa player.

Although it looks complicated, due to the Catalan's desire to rest and because of the refusal he gave to Italy this very summer, U.S. Soccer is in no rush this year to appoint a coach, since after this FIFA window its next matches are not until March 2027, which gives them more time to convince a high-profile coach, among whom Guardiola should be, according to reports this Wednesday.

articles.title: Former Brazil star Adriano shows he's still got it while playing street soccer in a humble neighborhood
articles.summary: Former Brazilian international Adriano Leite Ribeiro, famously nicknamed The Emperor, has gone viral after footage showed him performing an impressive series of soccer tricks on a street in Brazil. The video circulated widely on November 10 and 11, 2026, reminding fans of the technical ability that once made him one of the world's most feared strikers.
articles.body:
Former Brazilian international Adriano Leite Ribeiro, famously nicknamed The Emperor, has gone viral after footage showed him performing an impressive series of soccer tricks on a street in Brazil. The video circulated widely on November 10 and 11, 2026, reminding fans of the technical ability that once made him one of the world's most feared strikers.

Appearing shirtless and wearing shorts and flip-flops, the 44-year-old former Inter Milan striker completed 32 consecutive touches without letting the ball hit the ground. His demonstration included balancing the ball on his head and moving it between his legs, attracting admiration from viewers who remembered his playing days.

Adriano enjoyed the peak of his career at Inter Milan, where he won domestic trophies and became famous for his powerful left foot. He also played a decisive role in Brazil's 2004 Copa América victory, finishing as the tournament's leading scorer with seven goals and scoring a late equalizer against Argentina in the final. His career was later affected by injuries and personal struggles, and he retired professionally in 2016.
